page.layout: One page of running text with a woodcut ornament at the head and a decorative initial block to the left of the first paragraph; marginal notes in the right margin. Below the text, the gathering signature "S 4" at the foot.

main_text.head: QUARTUS ANNALIUM TACITI liber per Aphorismos explicatus.
Uni summam rerum committere, perniciosum principi.
main_text.p: QUOD Thraso in Eunucho Terentia-no jactar, regem Persarum sibi credere omnem exercitum, consilia: id Ast.3.Sc.I. Ælio Sejano apud Tiberium imperatorem contigit. Sejani po-tentia. Quamvis enim non omnibus legionibus, cohortibus tamen prætoriis, quod unum robur erat urbanæ militiæ, præfecit. In consiliis vero communicandis adeo sibi devinctum imperatorem Sejanus habuit, ut obscurum adversum alios sibi uni incautum intellectumque efficeret. Quod magis in Tiberio mirere: socium laborum, non modo in sermonibus domesticis, verum in curia apud patres, in foro apud populum jactavit. quin & effigies ejus per theatra & fora, inter principia legionum coli permisit. Inde major in eum popularium, fictè an sincerè colentium, inclinatio. Qua in re varie à Tiberio, cæteris in rebus imperandi gnaro, er-ratum. 1. Omnia invadere, deturbato sede Principe, Tiberii er-rata. moliuntur, quibus tanta regnandi occasio. Quod Drusus Tiberii filius non vano augurio cognovit: Primas dominandi spes in arduo: ubi sis ingressus, adesse studia

page.notes: Woodcut ornament at the head and decorative initial block are not printed text. The initial letter of "QUOD" is printed in a decorative block; read as QUOD with the Q partly obscured. Marginal note "Tiberii er-rata." is read from a faint, slightly blurred print; the hyphenation is as printed. The reference "Ast.3.Sc.I." is read as Act.3.Sc.I. and written with plain s as printed in the long-s form.
